body.statement: For all \(k,k'\in\mathcal K_n\), mutual independence and centeredness on \(\mathcal Q_n^+\) give the algebraic identity \[\operatorname{Cov}_{P_n}\!\left(\sum_{q\in\mathcal Q_n^{\mathrm{IF}}}c_{kq}e_q,\sum_{q\in\mathcal Q_n^{\mathrm{IF}}}c_{k'q}e_q\right)=\Omega_{kk'}=\sum_{q\in\mathcal Q_{n,kk'}^{\mathrm{sh}}}c_{kq}c_{k'q}\sigma_q^2.\] Terms outside \(\mathcal Q_{n,kk'}^{\mathrm{sh}}\) vanish by definition, and \(\Omega_{kk'}\ne0\) if and only if the displayed signed shared-cell sum is nonzero; individual products may cancel. Studentization is the identity \(\Sigma_n=D_n^{-1}\Omega_nD_n^{-1}\).
body.justification: This bookkeeping lemma fixes the signed shared-cell covariance that the feasible rate theorem and multiplier law must estimate.
body.gap: The identity is not an independent novelty claim; it records the covariance implied by the exact aggregated Choi--Yuan coefficients.
body.consumer: It prevents implementations from treating overlapping donor and pre-treatment cells as independent blocks.
